title: A discourse analysis of fuel subsidy reduction: revisiting the political economy of Indonesia’s experiences
core_idea: Use discourse analysis of purposively sampled news articles from two credible media outlets to investigate the actors and narratives shaping fuel subsidy reduction debates in Indonesia, treating media as an arena for policy contestation and situating reform within political economy frameworks.
tldr: Analyzes media discourse to trace how actors and narratives frame fuel subsidy reduction debates in Indonesia, aiming to provide a political economy perspective useful for scholars and policymakers.
